messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync with ENG + Security to finalize Acme POC scope. Need to lock success criteria, integration steps (SDK/auth/streaming), rate limits, pricing assumptions, and EU residency. Can folks chime in?

Devon Patel: Happy to. Proposed success criteria: 1) p95 latency < 300ms for 512-token requests, 2) >=90% pass on our prompt eval set, 3) end-to-end streaming integration with graceful retries. Timeline: 2-week runway. Thoughts?

Kevin Liu: Latency target looks reasonable on Dedicated with 13b quant + KV cache. Need expected QPS and whether batching is acceptable. Also which model family: 13b quant or 70b full fp?

Sam Ortiz: Customer expects peak ~50 qps, avg ~10 qps. Preference for 13b quant to keep costs down. Streaming is required for the UI (token-by-token).

Priya Rao: Two security asks: EU-only data residency + completed security questionnaire. We'll need SOC2 artifacts and KMS audit logs. What's the PII profile of the test data?

Maria Chen: They'll include emails and names in evals (test PII). They want KMS + audit logs for the POC. Also asked about retention policy options.

presales-bot: POC form received. POC ID: POC-824. Trial quota remaining: 120k tokens. Link: https://rwd.internal/poc/POC-824

Devon Patel: Integration notes for the SDK + auth — recommend API keys for POC, short-lived if possible. Example streaming snippet:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"REDACTED_API_KEY\")
resp = client.generate(model=\"rw-13b-q\", prompt=\"<prompt>\", stream=True)
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text)
```

Kevin Liu: For streaming + retries: implement idempotency keys for request-level retries. SDK supports resume tokens to pick up where stream left off. Retry strategy: exponential backoff with jitter; avoid client replays when using stateful generation.

Sam Ortiz: Rate limiting — we'll request dedicated capacity to cover 50 qps sustained. If customer goes multi-region (EU), Dedicated in eu-west needed. Pricing note: rough estimate for 13b quant Dedicated for that throughput ~ $XXk/month — will firm up after perf numbers.

Priya Rao: KMS options supported: AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault; we can do customer-managed keys for Private/Dedicated. For SOC2 artifacts, I'll start assembling the standard response pack. Also need confirmation on retention period for logs (they want 90 days).

Devon Patel: I'll assemble the prompt eval set and scoring rubric (exact match for structured responses, fuzzy BLEU/ROUGE threshold for free text). Uploading to shared drive and will post link by EOD.

Kevin Liu: I'll run perf tests Monday with rw-13b-q + KV cache enabled, batch size 8, synthetic 512-token traces. Will report p50/p95 and token/sec numbers. If we miss p95 target, we can propose micro-batching or bump instance type.

Maria Chen: Action items: Priya -> draft security questionnaire answers by EOD; Kevin -> perf numbers by Mon; Devon -> evals + rubric by EOD; Sam -> confirm EU tenancy + NDA status with customer. Aim to kick off POC next Tue.

Sam Ortiz: I'll confirm EU tenancy and ping legal on NDA today.

Priya Rao: Starting questionnaire now. Will also propose retention config (90d) and KMS flow for review.

Devon Patel: Upload complete: https://drive.internal/rw/poc-824/evals (scoresheet + test prompts). Linking example prompt set in the doc.

presales-bot: Reminder: POC checklist item added — \"Security questionnaire in progress\".

Maria Chen: Thanks — feel free to @me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
